rules.text_ownership: saea-obs-context-ownership-v1: the delivered text of a unit is its OWN turn's transcription only; each boundary is resolved once, on the overlap both neighbours transcribed

zero_contact: no frozen core, diarizer re-run, GPU, embedder, tokenizer, network or paid API; no MP3 decode and no resample, so ffmpeg stays absent. The only audio touch is a local PCM read of already-sealed slices, reduced to 20 ms frame energies and thrown away.
